items.question: Plan
items.sub: Steps 1 to 8: agree what to build.

videos.name: Plan stage
steps: Initial requirements
RAC states its needs, in its own words. BA: Capture and clarify them.
Feasibility
The developers check whether it can be built, and how. BA: Share the requirements and record any constraints.
Requirement gathering workshop
AvePoint and RAC go through every need in detail. With no requirements yet, it becomes a discovery workshop. BA: Prepare, facilitate and document the workshop.
Dev assessment
The developers flag anything unclear or risky. BA: Resolve the open points with RAC.
Confirmation
RAC confirms the requirements, in a reconfirmation workshop or by email. BA: Get the confirmation in writing.
Product backlog
BA: Write the user stories in Azure DevOps (ADO).
Effort estimation
The developers estimate each user story. BA: Support them with the scope.
Backlog sign-off
BA: Present the backlog to RAC and obtain sign-off.

videos.name: Build stage
steps: Dev kickoff and development
The developers build the release, story by story. BA: Answer developer questions and keep the stories current.
AvePoint QA
AvePoint QA tests the release and writes the test cases. BA: Review the test cases against the requirements.

videos.name: Test stage
steps: SIT
ITD's TCS QA team tests the release; defects are logged in ADO. Outcome: SIT sign-off. BA: Triage defects and confirm expected behaviour.
UAT
RAC tests the release as real users would. Outcome: UAT sign-off. BA: Run the UAT briefing, prepare the UAT guide and support RAC through testing.
UAT completion report
BA: Prepare the report of what was tested, found and fixed.

videos.name: Go Live stage
steps: CAB preparation
BA: Prepare the Change Advisory Board (CAB) material.
Production deployment
The release goes live, outside office hours where needed. BA: Coordinate communication.
Sanity testing
TCS QA checks production. Outcome: QA sign-off. BA: Confirm the result with RAC.
Hypercare
Close monitoring after go-live; fixes in this period are hotfixes. BA: Track issues and hotfixes.
